review_method: Sequential source-first semantic review across the exact 29 dimensions. Poem body, YAML heading metadata and printed source note remain provenance-distinct; uncertainty, loss and lacunae are preserved.

literary_domain.note: Naṟṟiṇai is treated as Akam work context; this is not inferred from the body.

tinai.note: Exact printed tiṇai field retained, including uncertainty or attached source wording.

speaker.note: Printed source note retains dramatic roles/context as provenance-distinct evidence; no scene is reconstructed beyond its wording.

poet.note: Printed poet attribution retained as an unresolved mention; null and question-mark forms remain unresolved.

landscape_environment.note: Exact environmental/place-form wording retained; no conventional tiṇai ecology or modern geography is imported.

season_weather_time.note: Exact time, season or weather wording retained without calendrical reconstruction.

flora.note: Exact plant/flower wording retained without modern botanical identification.

people_social_roles.note: Exact human role wording retained without converting it into later identity categories.

relationships.note: Exact relationship, attachment or separation wording retained without reconstructing legal status.

emotion_lived_experience.note: Exact affective or lived-experience wording retained without retrospective diagnosis.

food_subsistence.note: Exact food or subsistence wording retained without quantified historical inference.

material_culture_everyday_objects.note: Exact object/material-culture wording retained; similes are not promoted into historical events.

weapons_warfare.note: Exact weapon/conflict wording retained; no external battle is identified.

mobility_transport.note: Exact movement, route or conveyance wording retained without reconstructing an itinerary.

settlements_built_environment.note: Exact settlement or built-space wording retained without modern place identification.

arts_music_performance.note: Exact music/performance wording retained; comparison imagery is not treated as an actual event.

body_health.note: Exact bodily or health-language retained without retrospective medical diagnosis.

textual_intertextual_relationships.note: Exact textual/reference wording retained without inferring an external historical identity.
